_doc: Site-wide announcement manifest. Single source of truth for what the site currently surfaces in the fixed banner above the nav (and the homepage hero / library hub / learn home / footer 'what's new' line). An entry is a publishing event the banner points at: either a weekly article batch (type omitted or 'batch') or a standalone launch like a course (type 'course'). Each carries the per-locale pill label, headline, blurb, CTA, and overview URL the banner renders.
_status: v2 — 2026-05-30. Now drives course/standalone launches as well as weekly batches via an optional 'type' field ('course' renders a marigold pill + course CTA; default renders the blue 'New this week' batch pill). Add an entry, set 'current_batch' to its key, run scripts/inject-batch-banner.mjs to push the banner across all pages. Old entries stay for reference; only current_batch shows. type:'course' fields: pill_en/es (the pill text), headline_en/es (Fraunces italic line), cta_en/es, overview_en/es (the destination).
_consumed_by: scripts/inject-batch-banner.mjs (renders the site-wide banner), homepage 'Latest batch' section (manual link to overview), and future scripts/build-library-recent.mjs may use the batch metadata to badge articles that belong to it.
_cadence: One batch per week, Sun 8pm ET → Mon 9am ET publish window. expires = date + 14 days (banner shows for two weeks; after that, the next batch should already be in place and current_batch flipped). If a week is genuinely quiet, leave the prior batch's entry as current — the cadence is editorial, not robotic.
